repairs.change: On a destination collision, skip only the current file (`continue`) instead of returning from the whole batch, so later valid sessions are still migrated and both colliding files keep their bytes.
Push the parsed unterminated final JSONL record into `entries` before the trailing-newline repair, so the tail record is retained exactly once and subsequent reads are idempotent.

validation.notes: The executable .prale-eval/regression.mjs links the real submitted modules through the read-only subject.mjs pipeline (real migrations.ts, utils/text.ts, utils/paths.ts and core/session-manager.ts; only the agent-dir boundary and directory ordering are supplied). It builds a local batch under .prale-eval/ where a colliding session sorts first, a valid Unicode session with an unterminated final record plus an interleaved malformed line sorts second, and an unmigratable malformed header sorts third. Assertions cover: migration continues past the collision and moves the later session byte-identically; colliding source and destination bytes stay unchanged across repeated batch runs; ordered Unicode payloads (Latin-1 accents, CJK, emoji) parse in order with the malformed line skipped; the tail record is retained exactly once and exactly one newline is appended; an immediate re-read returns identical entries and does not append another newline; SessionManager.open sees the same tail through its own loader; a second fixture places a 4-byte emoji exactly across the 1 MiB read-chunk boundary to prove StringDecoder ordering; and migration/session agree on the session directory encoding. Run on the repaired tree: exit 0, all assertions passed. Mutation check: restoring migrations.ts alone to its faulty `return` baseline produced `AssertionError: migration must continue past a colliding file and move the later valid session` at regression.mjs:106; restoring core/session-manager.ts alone to its faulty discarded-tail baseline produced `AssertionError: the unterminated final record must be retained once, in order, after malformed lines are skipped` at regression.mjs:144. Both were uncaught node:assert/strict AssertionErrors, not crashes, import errors or timeouts. Fixtures are created under .prale-eval/.session-integrity-tmp and removed in a finally block after every run; no dependencies, network, credentials, real time or randomness are used as correctness evidence.
